Here.sql:
WITH t_0_Here_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      Presence.person AS person,
      Presence.place AS place
    FROM
      Clock, Presence
    WHERE
      (Clock.tick >= Presence.start) AND
      (Clock.tick < Presence.stop) AND
      (Clock.world = 'night')
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      'self' AS person,
      Place.place AS place
    FROM
      Clock AS t_1_Clock, Place
    WHERE
      (t_1_Clock.tick >= Place.start) AND
      (t_1_Clock.tick < Place.stop) AND
      (t_1_Clock.world = 'night')
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  )
SELECT
  Here_MultBodyAggAux.person AS person,
  Here_MultBodyAggAux.place AS place
FROM
  t_0_Here_MultBodyAggAux AS Here_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY Here_MultBodyAggAux.person, Here_MultBodyAggAux.place

Trust.sql:
SELECT
  Bond.person AS person,
  SUM(Bond.weight) AS score
FROM
  Bond
GROUP BY Bond.person

EligibleScene.sql:
WITH t_1_SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      t_2_Scene.scene AS scene,
      Here.place AS place
    FROM
      Scene AS t_2_Scene, Here
    WHERE
      (t_2_Scene.place = 'with_actor') AND
      (Here.person = t_2_Scene.actor)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      t_3_Scene.scene AS scene,
      t_3_Scene.place AS place
    FROM
      Scene AS t_3_Scene, Here AS t_4_Here
    WHERE
      (t_3_Scene.place != 'with_actor') AND
      (t_4_Here.person = t_3_Scene.actor) AND
      (t_4_Here.place = t_3_Scene.place)
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  ),
t_0_SceneLocation AS (SELECT
  SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux.scene AS scene,
  SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux.place AS place
FROM
  t_1_SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux AS SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux.scene, SceneLocation_MultBodyAggAux.place),
t_5_MissingKnowledge AS (SELECT
  NeedKnowledge.scene AS scene
FROM
  NeedKnowledge
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_46.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Knows, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_46
  WHERE
    (Knows.clue = NeedKnowledge.clue)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY NeedKnowledge.scene),
t_6_MissingItem AS (SELECT
  NeedItem.scene AS scene
FROM
  NeedItem
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_57.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Item, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_57
  WHERE
    (Item.item = NeedItem.item) AND
    (Item.holder = NeedItem.holder)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY NeedItem.scene),
t_7_MissingConsent AS (SELECT
  NeedConsent.scene AS scene
FROM
  NeedConsent
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_68.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Consent, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_68
  WHERE
    (Consent.person = NeedConsent.person) AND
    (Consent.topic = NeedConsent.topic)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY NeedConsent.scene),
t_8_MissingChoice AS (SELECT
  NeedChoice.scene AS scene
FROM
  NeedChoice
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_79.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Choice, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_79
  WHERE
    (Choice.topic = NeedChoice.topic) AND
    (Choice.value = NeedChoice.value)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY NeedChoice.scene),
t_10_MissingBond_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      NeedBond.scene AS scene
    FROM
      NeedBond, Trust
    WHERE
      (Trust.score < NeedBond.minimum) AND
      (Trust.person = NeedBond.person)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      t_11_NeedBond.scene AS scene
    FROM
      NeedBond AS t_11_NeedBond
    WHERE
      ((SELECT
        MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_97.value)) AS logica_value
      FROM
        Trust AS t_12_Trust, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_97
      WHERE
        (t_12_Trust.person = t_11_NeedBond.person)) IS NULL)
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  ),
t_9_MissingBond AS (SELECT
  MissingBond_MultBodyAggAux.scene AS scene
FROM
  t_10_MissingBond_MultBodyAggAux AS MissingBond_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY MissingBond_MultBodyAggAux.scene)
SELECT
  Scene.scene AS scene,
  Scene.title AS title,
  SceneLocation.place AS place,
  Scene.actor AS actor,
  Scene.priority AS priority,
  Scene.cost AS cost
FROM
  Scene, t_0_SceneLocation AS SceneLocation, Clock
WHERE
  (Clock.tick >= Scene.earliest) AND
  (Clock.tick < Scene.latest) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_37.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Seen, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_37
  WHERE
    (Seen.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_40.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_5_MissingKnowledge AS MissingKnowledge, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_40
  WHERE
    (MissingKnowledge.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_49.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_6_MissingItem AS MissingItem, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_49
  WHERE
    (MissingItem.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_60.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_7_MissingConsent AS MissingConsent, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_60
  WHERE
    (MissingConsent.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_71.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_8_MissingChoice AS MissingChoice, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_71
  WHERE
    (MissingChoice.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_82.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_9_MissingBond AS MissingBond, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_82
  WHERE
    (MissingBond.scene = Scene.scene)) IS NULL) AND
  (SceneLocation.scene = Scene.scene) AND
  (Clock.world = 'night')
GROUP BY Scene.scene, Scene.title, SceneLocation.place, Scene.actor, Scene.priority, Scene.cost

NextForced.sql:
WITH t_1_HigherForced_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      t_2_EligibleScene.scene AS scene
    FROM
      EligibleScene AS t_2_EligibleScene, EligibleScene AS t_3_EligibleScene
    WHERE
      (t_3_EligibleScene.priority >= 100) AND
      (t_3_EligibleScene.priority > t_2_EligibleScene.priority)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      t_4_EligibleScene.scene AS scene
    FROM
      EligibleScene AS t_4_EligibleScene, EligibleScene AS t_5_EligibleScene
    WHERE
      (t_4_EligibleScene.priority >= 100) AND
      (t_5_EligibleScene.scene < t_4_EligibleScene.scene) AND
      (t_5_EligibleScene.priority = t_4_EligibleScene.priority)
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  ),
t_0_HigherForced AS (SELECT
  HigherForced_MultBodyAggAux.scene AS scene
FROM
  t_1_HigherForced_MultBodyAggAux AS HigherForced_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY HigherForced_MultBodyAggAux.scene)
SELECT
  EligibleScene.scene AS scene
FROM
  EligibleScene
WHERE
  (EligibleScene.priority >= 100) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_5.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_0_HigherForced AS HigherForced, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_5
  WHERE
    (HigherForced.scene = EligibleScene.scene)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY EligibleScene.scene

Opportunity.sql:
WITH t_1_HigherAtPlace_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      t_2_EligibleScene.scene AS scene
    FROM
      EligibleScene AS t_2_EligibleScene, EligibleScene AS t_3_EligibleScene
    WHERE
      (t_2_EligibleScene.priority < 100) AND
      (t_3_EligibleScene.priority < 100) AND
      (t_3_EligibleScene.priority > t_2_EligibleScene.priority) AND
      (t_3_EligibleScene.place = t_2_EligibleScene.place)
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      t_4_EligibleScene.scene AS scene
    FROM
      EligibleScene AS t_4_EligibleScene, EligibleScene AS t_5_EligibleScene
    WHERE
      (t_4_EligibleScene.priority < 100) AND
      (t_5_EligibleScene.scene < t_4_EligibleScene.scene) AND
      (t_5_EligibleScene.place = t_4_EligibleScene.place) AND
      (t_5_EligibleScene.priority = t_4_EligibleScene.priority)
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  ),
t_0_HigherAtPlace AS (SELECT
  HigherAtPlace_MultBodyAggAux.scene AS scene
FROM
  t_1_HigherAtPlace_MultBodyAggAux AS HigherAtPlace_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY HigherAtPlace_MultBodyAggAux.scene)
SELECT
  EligibleScene.scene AS scene,
  EligibleScene.title AS title,
  EligibleScene.place AS place,
  EligibleScene.actor AS actor,
  EligibleScene.cost AS cost
FROM
  EligibleScene
WHERE
  (EligibleScene.priority < 100) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_13.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_0_HigherAtPlace AS HigherAtPlace, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_13
  WHERE
    (HigherAtPlace.scene = EligibleScene.scene)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY EligibleScene.scene, EligibleScene.title, EligibleScene.place, EligibleScene.actor, EligibleScene.cost

BroadcastReady.sql:
SELECT
  'yes' AS ready
FROM
  Choice, Item, Knows, Knows AS t_0_Knows, Consent, Consent AS t_1_Consent
WHERE
  (Choice.topic = 'power') AND
  (Choice.value = 'on') AND
  (Item.item = 'master_tape') AND
  (Item.holder = 'station') AND
  (Knows.clue = 'recording_edited') AND
  (t_0_Knows.clue = 'voice_identity') AND
  (Consent.person = 'cheng') AND
  (Consent.topic = 'recording') AND
  (t_1_Consent.person = 'mi') AND
  (t_1_Consent.topic = 'broadcast')
GROUP BY ('yes' || '')

MutualFuture.sql:
SELECT
  Choice.value AS person
FROM
  Choice, Consent, Trust
WHERE
  (Trust.score >= 3) AND
  (Choice.topic = 'partner') AND
  (Consent.person = Choice.value) AND
  (Consent.topic = 'future') AND
  (Trust.person = Choice.value)
GROUP BY Choice.value

EligibleEnding.sql:
WITH t_0_EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      'cheng' AS ending,
      100 AS priority
    FROM
      Choice, MutualFuture
    WHERE
      (Choice.value != 'undecided') AND
      (Choice.topic = 'final') AND
      (MutualFuture.person = 'cheng')
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      'yao' AS ending,
      100 AS priority
    FROM
      Choice AS t_1_Choice, MutualFuture AS t_2_MutualFuture
    WHERE
      (t_1_Choice.value != 'undecided') AND
      (t_1_Choice.topic = 'final') AND
      (t_2_MutualFuture.person = 'yao')
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      'mi' AS ending,
      100 AS priority
    FROM
      Choice AS t_3_Choice, MutualFuture AS t_4_MutualFuture
    WHERE
      (t_3_Choice.value != 'undecided') AND
      (t_3_Choice.topic = 'final') AND
      (t_4_MutualFuture.person = 'mi')
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      'harbor' AS ending,
      50 AS priority
    FROM
      Choice AS t_5_Choice, BroadcastReady
    WHERE
      (t_5_Choice.topic = 'final') AND
      (t_5_Choice.value = 'broadcast') AND
      (BroadcastReady.ready = 'yes')
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      'quiet' AS ending,
      0 AS priority
    FROM
      Choice AS t_6_Choice
    WHERE
      (t_6_Choice.value != 'undecided') AND
      (t_6_Choice.topic = 'final')
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  )
SELECT
  EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux.ending AS ending,
  EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux.priority AS priority
FROM
  t_0_EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux AS EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux.ending, EligibleEnding_MultBodyAggAux.priority

NextEnding.sql:
WITH t_0_HigherEnding AS (SELECT
  t_1_EligibleEnding.ending AS ending
FROM
  EligibleEnding AS t_1_EligibleEnding, EligibleEnding AS t_2_EligibleEnding
WHERE
  (t_2_EligibleEnding.priority > t_1_EligibleEnding.priority)
GROUP BY t_1_EligibleEnding.ending)
SELECT
  EligibleEnding.ending AS ending
FROM
  EligibleEnding
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_4.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_0_HigherEnding AS HigherEnding, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_4
  WHERE
    (HigherEnding.ending = EligibleEnding.ending)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY EligibleEnding.ending

AvailableAction.sql:
WITH t_1_SelectableScene_MultBodyAggAux AS (SELECT * FROM (
  
    SELECT
      Opportunity.scene AS scene
    FROM
      Opportunity
   UNION ALL
  
    SELECT
      NextForced.scene AS scene
    FROM
      NextForced
  
) AS UNUSED_TABLE_NAME  ),
t_0_SelectableScene AS (SELECT
  SelectableScene_MultBodyAggAux.scene AS scene
FROM
  t_1_SelectableScene_MultBodyAggAux AS SelectableScene_MultBodyAggAux
GROUP BY SelectableScene_MultBodyAggAux.scene),
t_2_MissingActionPresence AS (SELECT
  ActionNeedsHere.scene AS scene,
  ActionNeedsHere.action AS action
FROM
  ActionNeedsHere
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_24.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Here, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_24
  WHERE
    (Here.person = ActionNeedsHere.person) AND
    (Here.place = ActionNeedsHere.place)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY ActionNeedsHere.scene, ActionNeedsHere.action),
t_3_MissingActionBroadcast AS (SELECT
  ActionNeedsBroadcast.scene AS scene,
  ActionNeedsBroadcast.action AS action
FROM
  ActionNeedsBroadcast
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_35.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    BroadcastReady, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_35
  WHERE
    (BroadcastReady.ready = 'yes')) IS NULL)
GROUP BY ActionNeedsBroadcast.scene, ActionNeedsBroadcast.action),
t_4_MissingActionChoice AS (SELECT
  ActionNeedsChoice.scene AS scene,
  ActionNeedsChoice.action AS action
FROM
  ActionNeedsChoice
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_49.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    Choice, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_49
  WHERE
    (Choice.topic = ActionNeedsChoice.topic) AND
    (Choice.value = ActionNeedsChoice.value)) IS NULL)
GROUP BY ActionNeedsChoice.scene, ActionNeedsChoice.action)
SELECT
  Action.scene AS scene,
  Action.action AS action
FROM
  Action, t_0_SelectableScene AS SelectableScene
WHERE
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_14.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_2_MissingActionPresence AS MissingActionPresence, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_14
  WHERE
    (MissingActionPresence.scene = Action.scene) AND
    (MissingActionPresence.action = Action.action)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_28.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_3_MissingActionBroadcast AS MissingActionBroadcast, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_28
  WHERE
    (MissingActionBroadcast.scene = Action.scene) AND
    (MissingActionBroadcast.action = Action.action)) IS NULL) AND
  ((SELECT
    MIN(MagicalEntangle(1, x_39.value)) AS logica_value
  FROM
    t_4_MissingActionChoice AS MissingActionChoice, JSON_EACH(JSON_ARRAY(0)) as x_39
  WHERE
    (MissingActionChoice.scene = Action.scene) AND
    (MissingActionChoice.action = Action.action)) IS NULL) AND
  (SelectableScene.scene = Action.scene)
GROUP BY Action.scene, Action.action
